name: Trademark Reimbursement Scheme

benefit: 50% reimbursement of trademark registration for company name and logo, up to ₹25,000. | Available to up to 200 start-ups per year, selected by the SITPC. | Benefits are subject to approval by SITPC and are not an entitlement.

name: Women Entrepreneur Vitality Scheme
agency: Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communication (DITE&C), Government of Goa
target_group: Women-led start-ups (woman founder with majority stake, aged 30 or under, company under 12 months old) incubated in a recognised Goa incubator, in emerging technologies
eligibility: Qualified startup with a woman founder holding the majority stake and the company must be less than 12 months old from the date of application. | Founder must be 30 years of age or younger. | Startup should not have any other source of income besides the established company | Must not have received similar grants from any government institution or agency. | Must be incubated in a recognised incubator in Goa throughout the support period. | Must submit quarterly progress reports through the associated incubator/accelerator/partner organisation.
benefit: Monthly stipend of ₹20,000 for up to 12 months for eligible women-led startups. | Applicable to startups working in AI, IoT, Drones, Robotics, AR/VR, AVGC, 3D Printing, and other emerging technologies. | Scheme available for a maximum period of one year | Limited to 50 beneficiaries per financial year.
how_to_apply: Application mode: Offline. 1. Apply for the scheme only during the relevant financial year after incurring the eligible expenditure. 2. Open the UDP portal and navigate to schemes tab. 3. Select Women Entrepreneur Vitality Scheme from the list of offline schemes. 4. Click on the Application Form button to download. 5. Enter your name, mobile number, email ID and district to show your interest. 6. Fill out the form and attach the required documents. 7. Submit the application to the concerned department in the prescribed format. Contact: dir-dit.goa@nic.gov.in
documents: Copy of Aadhaar card/s of the applicant | Declaration of no income from other sources | Report of the project/Pitch deck | Original Proof of Payment towards project expenses | Proof of majority ownership by women founder(s) | Letter from the incubator confirming current incubation | The form and documents as mentioned in Annexure 1
valid_period: Scheme document says it is framed under the Goa Start-up Policy 2025 (policy vision to 2028); eligibility clause refers to expenditure after notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2021 within the validity of the policy; no end date stated
portal_section: Schemes > State Government Schemes > Financial Support Scheme
notes: Goa Start-up Policy 2025 scheme implemented by the Start-up and IT Promotion Cell (SITPC). Scheme PDF carries no notification number or date. Offline application. max_rupees = Rs 20,000 per month stipend, for up to 12 months; 50 beneficiaries per year. Scheme PDFs on the portal: Women Entrepreneur Vitality Scheme <https://api.msme.goa.gov.in//Schemes/DetailsAndDocuments/b0e9306b-6f58-4426-994b-b7c5ed95deb4.pdf>

name: Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED)
agency: Quality Council of India (QCI), Government of India
target_group: All Udyam-registered MSMEs seeking ZED (Bronze/Silver/Gold) certification
eligibility: All MSMEs registered with the UDYAM registration portal (of the MoMSME) will be eligible to participate in MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certication and avail related benefits/incentives.
benefit: Subsidized ZED certification with joining rewards and special support for women-owned MSMEs. | Graded reduction in certification fees for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises. | Extra subsidy for SC/ST, NER, cluster-based, and aspirational district MSMEs. | Financial support up to ₹50,000 for testing and product certification. | Handholding and technology upgradation assistance up to ₹3 lakhs for ZED-certified MSMEs.
how_to_apply: Application mode: Online. 1. Visit the official ZED Certification Portal. 2. Take the ZED Pledge (mandatory). 3. Apply online for Bronze / Silver / Gold level certification. 4. Upload required documents and complete assessments: 5. Bronze: Document verification 6. Silver: Remote assessment 7. Gold: On-site assessment 8. Receive certification and avail incentives. 9. For more support, reach out to DITC, Udyog Bhavan, Near Azad Maidan, Panjim, Goa-403001. Apply link: https://zed.msme.gov.in/ Contact: info@qcin.org
documents: Udyam Registration Number of the enterprise | Mobile number associated with the Udyam Registration | Valid email ID for login credentials and communication
portal_section: Schemes > Central Ministry Schemes > Financial Support Scheme
notes: max_rupees = Rs 3 lakh handholding/technology-upgradation assistance cap (testing/certification support up to Rs 50,000). Scheme PDFs on the portal: Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) Details <https://api.msme.goa.gov.in//Schemes/DetailsAndDocuments/2782cc3e-3933-42d4-8377-2e165dafd0c3.pdf>

name: RAMP Goa: 50% subsidy for water and energy audits (Gender Inclusion and Greening Initiatives)
agency: Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC), Government of Goa, under the RAMP Programme (Ministry of MSME, World Bank-supported)
target_group: MSMEs in Goa conducting water and energy audits

portal_section: About > RAMP > Gender Inclusion and Greening Initiatives for MSMEs in Goa
notes: Only rupee-denominated benefit found outside the Schemes section. Eligibility, application procedure and documents are not stated on the page.
